There seems to be a tourism bug in skylines when you place to many custom monument assets.

Tourist, External passenger trains and cruise ships stop spawning. Tourism basically totally collapses. (the basic tourism is very low anyway)

This phenomenon seems to be linked to the total attractiveness of the monument assets in your city combined. It is not just 1 single asset fucking things up.

You can fix this temporarily by:

  1. Lowering the monuments budget all the way down to 50% (which lowers the overall city attractiveness)
  2. Close down monuments till you see tourist arriving again.
  3. Delete your last few monuments until tourist arrive again and stop placing them.

I really think CO should fix this cap problem as it makes tourism totally useless in bigger cities.
